title: The Scaffold That Unties Itself
story: High on the scaffolding of the Skyspire, a long-tailed rope-eating lizard named Wendralith is chewing the rigging loose while three stonemasons huddle on the top platform. Mr 6 grabs the hand-crank and starts winching the platform down: it drops 7.5 feet every minute, but Wendralith's chewing lets the rope slip back up 2.25 feet each minute. The platform starts 63 feet above the safe courtyard.
question: How many minutes will it take the platform to reach the courtyard?
solution: Each minute the platform really drops 7.5 - 2.25 = 5.25 feet.
Divide the height by the real drop: 63 / 5.25 = 12 minutes.
The masons touch down in 12 minutes.
praise: Subtracting the slip-back was exactly the right first move — the last step was dividing the full 63 feet by that true drop.
hint: Wendralith undoes part of every crank — find how far the platform really falls in one whole minute first.
victory: The platform kissed the courtyard stones right on schedule, and Wendralith — out of rope to chew — sheepishly began braiding the frayed ends back together. Mr 6 hired her as the realm's first knot inspector.
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight with a blue cape cranking a winch on a tall stone spire scaffold while a long ribbon-like lizard gnaws the ropes, three masons clinging to the descending platform in golden late-afternoon light.
